name: CSN 3112 跑线 宣布燃油紧急

cards.audioText: B: Your call sign is CSN 112, a flight from Beijing to Guangzhou, the preceding aircraft reported a squall line 100 miles ahead on the weather radar, contact Beijing Control and request turn right to circumnavigate the weather.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你的呼号是 CSN 112，从北京飞往广州，前机报告气象雷达上前方 100 海里有飑线，联系北京管制并请求右转绕飞天气。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Control, CSN 3112, the preceding aircraft reported a squall line 100 miles ahead on the weather radar, request turn right to avoid it.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京管制，CSN 3112，前机报告气象雷达上前方 100 海里有飑线，请求右转避让。

cards.audioText: C: CSN 112, Beijing Control, negative due prohibited area, turn left 30 degrees, track out 35 kilometers, report clear of CB.
cards.audioTextZh: C：CSN 112，北京管制，因禁区不能同意，左转 30 度，偏航 35 公里，报告脱离 CB。
cards.referenceText: Turn left 30 degrees, track out 35 kilometers, report clear of CB, CSN 3112.
cards.referenceTextZh: 左转 30 度，偏航 35 公里，报告脱离 CB，CSN 3112。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are clear of CB and closing back to the course, contact Beijing Control.
cards.audioTextZh: B：现在你已脱离 CB，正回到航路，联系北京管制。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Control, CSN 3112, clear of CB and closing back to the course.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京管制，CSN 3112，已脱离 CB，正回到航路。

cards.audioText:
C: CSN 112, the preceding aircraft reported severe turbulence of 10400 meters, 11000 meters is available, what's your intention?
B: Acknowledge the transmission and tell the controller you'd like to climb to 11000 meters.
cards.audioTextZh:
C：CSN 112，前机报告 10400 米有严重颠簸，11000 米可用，你的意图？
B：确认收到并告诉管制员你想爬升至 11000 米。
cards.referenceText: Roger, request climb to 11000 meters, CSN 3112.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，请求爬升至 11000 米，CSN 3112。

cards.audioText: C: CSN 112, climb to and maintain 11000 meters.
cards.referenceText: Climb to and maintain 11000 meters, CSN 3112.

cards.audioText: C: CSN 112, after passing MUDAM, fly direct to ASAVA.
cards.audioTextZh: C：CSN 112，过 MUDAM 后，直飞 ASAVA。
cards.referenceText: After passing MUDAM, fly direct to ASAVA, CSN 3112.
cards.referenceTextZh: 过 MUDAM 后，直飞 ASAVA，CSN 3112。

cards.audioText: C: CSN 112, orbit right from present position until advised to weather ahead.
cards.audioTextZh: C：CSN 112，从当前位置右盘旋，直到另行通知，因前方天气。
cards.referenceText: Orbit right from present position until advised, CSN 3112.
cards.referenceTextZh: 从当前位置右盘旋，直到另行通知，CSN 3112。

cards.audioText: B: After several orbits, you find you don't have enough fuel to hold any further, report the situation to Beijing Control.
cards.audioTextZh: B：几圈盘旋后，你发现没有足够燃油继续等待，向北京管制报告情况。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Control, CSN 3112, we don't have enough fuel to hold any further.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京管制，CSN 3112，我们没有足够燃油继续等待。

cards.audioText:
C: CSN 7112, roger, say your intention.
B: Tell the controller you require radar vector to Beijing for priority landing.
cards.audioTextZh:
C：CSN 7112，收到，说明意图。
B：告诉管制员你需要雷达引导到北京优先落地。
cards.referenceText: Request radar vector to Beijing for priority landing, CSN 3112.
cards.referenceTextZh: 请求雷达引导到北京优先落地，CSN 3112。

cards.audioText: C: CSN 112, roger, turn left heading 190, fly direct to GUVBA.
cards.audioTextZh: C：CSN 112，收到，左转航向 190，直飞 GUVBA。
cards.referenceText: Then left heading 190, fly direct to GUVBA, CSN 3112.

cards.audioText: C: CSN 112, turn left heading 150, direct to AA446, hold at AA446 as published due weather.
cards.audioTextZh: C：CSN 112，左转航向 150，直飞 AA446，因天气在 AA446 按公布程序等待。
cards.referenceText: Turn left heading 150, direct to AA446, hold at AA446 as published, CSN 3112.
cards.referenceTextZh: 左转航向 150，直飞 AA446，在 AA446 按公布程序等待，CSN 3112。

cards.audioText: B: You have been holding at AA446 for about 30 minutes, you are reaching the minimum fuel situation, contact Beijing Control and request leave the hold and land as soon as possible.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你已在 AA446 等待约 30 分钟，正接近最低燃油状态，联系北京管制并请求离开等待并尽快着陆。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Control, CSN 3112, we have been holding at AA446 for about 30 minutes, we are reaching the minimum fuel situation, request leave the hold and land as soon as possible.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京管制，CSN 3112，我们已在 AA446 等待约 30 分钟，正接近最低燃油状态，请求离开等待并尽快着陆。

cards.audioText: C: CSN 112, roger, leave the hold, proceed to LADIX, descent to 6000 meters, contact Beijing Approach on 119.35, we have informed them about your situation.
cards.audioTextZh: C：CSN 112，收到，离开等待，前往 LADIX，下降至 6000 米，联系北京进近119.35，我们已通知他们你的情况。
cards.referenceText: Leave the hold, proceed to LADIX, descent to 6000 meters, 119.35, roger, thanks, CSN 3112.
cards.referenceTextZh: 离开等待，前往 LADIX，下降至 6000 米，119.35，收到，谢谢，CSN 3112。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are over LADIX, maintaining 6000 meters, you have received information L, contact Beijing Approach.
cards.audioTextZh: B：现在你在 LADIX 上空，保持 6000 米，已收到通播 L，联系北京进近。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Approach, CSN 3112, over LADIX, maintaining 6000 meters, information L.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京进近，CSN 3112，LADIX 上空，保持 6000 米，通播 L。

cards.audioText: C: CSN 7112, Beijing Approach, radar contact, descent to 4200 meters, expect radar vector ILS approach Runway 36R.
cards.audioTextZh: C：CSN 7112，北京进近，雷达识别，下降至 4200 米，预计雷达引导 ILS 进近跑道 36R。
cards.referenceText: Descent to 4200 meters, expect radar vector ILS approach Runway 36R, CSN 3112.
cards.referenceTextZh: 下降至 4200 米，预计雷达引导 ILS 进近跑道 36R，CSN 3112。

cards.audioText:
C: CSN 7112, are you declaring fuel emergency?
B: Tell the controller that you are declaring fuel emergency and request priority landing Runway 36R.
cards.audioTextZh:
C：CSN 7112，你是否宣布燃油紧急情况？
B：告诉管制员你宣布燃油紧急情况，并请求跑道 36R 优先着陆。
cards.referenceText: We are declaring fuel emergency and request priority landing Runway 36R, CSN 3112.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我们宣布燃油紧急情况，请求跑道 36R 优先着陆，CSN 3112。

cards.audioText: C: CSN 112, roger, you are number 1 to land, cleared straight in ILS approach Runway 36R, report established.
cards.audioTextZh: C：CSN 112，收到，你是落地第 1 架，许可直线 ILS 进近跑道 36R，报告建立。
cards.referenceText: Cleared straight in ILS approach Runway 36R, report established, CSN 3112.
cards.referenceTextZh: 许可直线 ILS 进近跑道 36R，报告建立，CSN 3112。

cards.audioText: B: Now you have established on ILS approach Runway 36R, contact Beijing Tower.
cards.audioTextZh: B：现在你已建立 ILS 进近跑道 36R，联系北京塔台。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Tower, CSN 3112, established on ILS approach Runway 36R.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京塔台，CSN 3112，已建立 ILS 进近跑道 36R。

cards.audioText: C: CSN 112, Beijing Tower, Runway 36R, clear to land.
cards.audioTextZh: C：CSN 112，北京塔台，跑道 36R，可以落地。
